hardware-report.yml

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/hardware-report.yml in sndstation, 96 lines · download

# Draft for #144.
name: Hardware report
description: What worked and what did not on a real unit.
labels: ["hardware"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        One report per unit and image. How to measure and what to include: docs/hardware/reporting.md.
  - type: input
    id: unit
    attributes:
      label: Unit model
      description: The model on the case, for example Anbernic RG35XX SP.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: slot
    attributes:
      label: Slot
      description: The unit's slot number in docs/hardware/supported.md.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: soc
    attributes:
      label: SoC
      description: The CPU row on ABOUT, for example Rockchip RK3326.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: dropdown
    id: image
    attributes:
      label: Image it runs
      options:
        - sndstation rootfs
        - ROCKNIX
        - stock BSP
        - other (say which below)
    validations:
      required: true
  # TODO(#236/#124): how an image states its own version.
  - type: input
    id: image-version
    attributes:
      label: Image name or date
      description: The name or date of the image the unit runs.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: version
    attributes:
      label: sndstation version
      description: From ABOUT, or the release tag.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: unit-id
    attributes:
      label: Unit id
      description: The SOC ID row on ABOUT.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: rtbench
    attributes:
      label: "`--rt-bench` output"
      description: The whole output of each run (docs/hardware/reporting.md says how). If you could not run it, say why.
      render: shell
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: must-show
    attributes:
      label: What the slot's "must show" says
      description: One line per item in the unit's private-beta issue, each marked shown, not shown, or could not be tried.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: config
    attributes:
      label: Config files
      description: Paste or attach ~/.config/sndstation/gamepads.json if Map this controller saved it, and the `rings` entry `sndstation --led-slots` printed.
  - type: textarea
    id: worked
    attributes:
      label: What worked
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: failed
    attributes:
      label: What did not work
      description: What you did, what you expected, and what happened instead.
    validations:
      required: true
